name: AI assistant
description: Ask a language model, through the organization's own provider and budget. The provider and its key are the kernel's; the plugin sends only the conversation.

capabilities.name: Ask a language model
capabilities.description: Complete a conversation: directly (ai::complete), as a queued request with a callback (ai::submit, ai::result), and the provider's state (ai::status).

capabilities.name: Embed texts
capabilities.description: Turn texts into vectors (ai::embed), and remember a plugin's own text for search by meaning (ai::index, ai::search, ai::forget).
